posts.body_html:
The mother of some seriously amazing giant hybrids! Looking back at pictures from a long time ago, I remember just how easy it was to grow this clone, but it was equally easy to lose it! That mother plant you see in the pics rotted out and I lost EVERYTHING! Fast forward to 2021, I acquired another division from my home skillet with a side of hash browns ROB CHIGGITY CHOCOLATEY COCO-MOE of the pitcher plant project, he 4 show hooked me up the real deal! 2 years ago, I thought I had lost this thing to a freeze that absolutely JACKED up a big portion of my roseas, but it recovered last grow season and it's lookin...aiiite homie, it's aiiiite....Just glad to still have this in the collection, I took a back rhizome division so hopefully there will be something that comes from it that I can offer to someone else so that it'll be more secure in collections.

Photos taken 2/12/25:


This thang is lookin more bulbous than it did at my old spot! Thing is, Rob C.C. C-Moe got this thing to look BULBOUS AS SHIIIII....take mushrooms....yeah that's it....back in the day when he grew his plants in Daly Shiddi....errr, City!
